IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Transportation (originally sponsored by Senators Berkey, Hobbs, Haugen, Stevens, Shin, and McAuliffe)

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a state route number 2 route development plan.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a state route number 2 route development plan;creating a new section; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Subject to the availability of amountsappropriated for this specific purpose, the department oftransportation shall conduct a state route number 2 route developmentplan that will identify essential improvements needed between the portof Everett/Naval Station and approaching the state route number 9interchange near the city of Snohomish.
